items.name: tree-01
items.title: Basic tree
items.description: Help topics in folders that open with a click or the arrow keys, their rows arriving with height and opacity.

items.name: tree-02
items.title: Tree with guide lines
items.description: Vertical lines show which aisle each rack belongs to, and grow with the rows as a folder opens.

items.name: tree-03
items.title: Tree with icons
items.description: Folders and files with icons, the folder icon opening with its row.

items.name: tree-04
items.title: Chevron on the right
items.description: A book icon leads each shelf and opens with it, while the chevron sits at the end of the row.

items.name: tree-05
items.title: Drag and drop tree
items.description: Select several rows and drag them, or press Ctrl Shift D: they glide to their new place and the move is spoken.

items.name: tree-06
items.title: Renamable tree
items.description: Press F2 or Rename to edit the focused row in place, then it glides to its new place in the alphabet.

items.name: tree-07
items.title: Searchable tree
items.description: Typing opens every folder, highlights the matches and counts them; clearing the field brings back the folders you had open.

items.name: tree-08
items.title: Filterable tree
items.description: Only the matches and their folders stay in the tree.

items.name: tree-09
items.title: Double-click to open
items.description: A click selects a folder and a double click or Enter opens it, while the highlight glides to the selected row.

items.name: tree-10
items.title: Expand and collapse all
items.description: Two buttons open or close every folder, with the number of children at the end of each row.

items.name: tree-11
items.title: File explorer
items.description: A repository with an icon per file type, sorted again when a file is dropped on a folder.

items.name: tree-12
items.title: Navigation tree
items.description: Documentation links with the current page open and marked.

items.name: tree-13
items.title: Checkboxes on the right
items.description: A checkbox at the end of each row, folders following their items, and a count that rolls as boxes change.

items.name: tree-14
items.title: Checkboxes on the left
items.description: A checkbox before each row, folders following their items, with Select all and Clear under the tree.

items.name: tree-15
items.title: Checkable folders
items.description: Checking a folder checks it and everything inside it, and the number of documents rolls to the new total.

items.name: voice-01
items.title: Voice orb
items.description: A disc and a ring of fine bars drawn on a canvas: it breathes when idle, follows your voice or a simulated one, sweeps while thinking and swells while speaking.

items.name: voice-02
items.title: Voice note
items.description: A voice reply whose dots ink in as it plays, with a speed key that steps to 2x, seeking by click, drag or arrows, and a transcript that follows word by word.

items.name: voice-03
items.title: Dictation
items.description: A field whose microphone key turns the footer into a recording strip, then transcribes the take and streams the words in at the caret.

items.name: voice-04
items.title: Particle orb
items.description: A sphere of a few hundred particles that turns slowly and surges outward with the voice, then falls back on springs: it breathes when idle, tightens and spins while thinking, pulses while speaking, and one key starts and ends the call.

items.name: voice-05
items.title: Sound ring
items.description: A ring of rounded bars in three sizes where a peak travels round the ring and turns faster with the sound, quiet when idle, sitting beside a label, inside a button or alone.

items.name: agent-chat-01
items.title: Agent chat with its run
items.description: A conversation that thinks, reads its sources and streams, with the plan checking itself off beside it: when the agent needs a yes, the field you were typing in becomes the request and turns back once you answer.

items.name: agent-chat-02
items.title: Chat with an artifact
items.description: A chat beside the code an agent wrote, in panels you resize: the revision lands in place and only its new lines light up, with versions, a Changes view, Copy and Apply, and a sheet you drag down on phones.

items.name: agent-chat-03
items.title: Agent canvas
items.description: Someone says what should happen, the assistant checks off its work in the chat and three cards type their own fields on a canvas, one after the other, until Run it becomes Live.

items.name: agent-chat-04
items.title: Voice mode
items.description: A voice call whose disc breathes with whoever speaks while the page beside it fills in: notes as they are said, to-dos with an owner and a date, and the ones the assistant does tick themselves, with Undo.

items.name: agent-ops-01
items.title: Agents overview
items.description: A day of agents at a glance: totals that roll between Today and 7 days, requests approved in place, a fleet whose rows unfold their sub-agents, and when the last request leaves a check draws itself where the list was.

items.name: agent-ops-02
items.title: Evals before shipping
items.description: A candidate prompt against the one in production: Run evals fills the grid cell by cell while the pass rate rolls, a regression opens both replies side by side with the failing part marked, and Ship waits until each one is decided.

items.name: agent-ops-03
items.title: AI service status
items.description: A status page for an AI product: one uptime bar per service read day by day, p50 and p95 lines that glide to the service you pick, and an incident that writes its updates until the orb turns green again.

items.name: agent-ops-04
items.title: MCP servers
items.description: The servers an agent can reach, each unfolding its tools with Enabled and Ask first switches: Reconnect becomes a spinner then Connected, and the Add server dialog resizes from Testing to Failed with the reason, then to Connected with its tools.

items.name: agent-ops-05
items.title: MCP install
items.description: Pick an editor and its exact config crossfades in, Remote or Local and the project switch light the lines they change, and after Copy the edge of the card takes the colour of that editor and waits for its first connection.

items.name: agent-ops-06
items.title: Webhooks
items.description: Endpoints beside the detail of the one you pick: a failed delivery opens its response, payload and headers, Retry turns into a spinner then Delivered while the delivery rate rolls back up, and a new endpoint shows its signing secret once.

items.name: agent-ops-07
items.title: Agent builder
items.description: One agent on a card, with its model, instructions, tools and knowledge files that upload, and a Test tab that answers: Publish opens what changed and three sample prompts that run, fails once, then Retry draws the check of the new live version.

items.name: agent-ops-08
items.title: Agent board
items.description: A run as three lanes: when an agent hands in its work the card travels to Needs review, Approve sends it on to Done, Request changes sends it back with a note, and cards also move by drag or from their menu.

items.name: agent-ops-09
items.title: Run pivot
items.description: A pivot table over agent runs: a field chip flies from the list into Rows, Columns, Values or Filters and the shaded table regroups while it is still held, with subtotals, folding groups, Swap, a CSV export and a question box that fills the wells.

items.name: agent-review-01
items.title: Task to merge
items.description: A task laid out like an issue: the status chip rolls from Planned to Merged while the activity grows, one approval starts the work, a failed check is re-run and Merge becomes Merging, then Merged.

items.name: agent-review-02
items.title: Code review with agent replies
items.description: A file diff where a comment on a line gets a reply with a suggested change: Apply suggestion becomes Applied in a commit, the new lines light up in the file and the thread folds once resolved.

items.name: agent-review-03
items.title: Document extract
items.description: A purchase order beside the typed fields read from it: values stream in with a confidence, a thread draws from a value to its box on the page, doubtful values wait for a confirm or an edit and Accept all becomes Saved.

items.name: agent-review-04
items.title: Computer use session
items.description: An agent working in a browser drawn on the page: its named pointer glides from one control to the next, every action is a frame you can scrub back to, you can pause or take over, and the payment waits for your yes.

items.name: agent-review-05
items.title: Agents in a document
items.description: Two agents edit a brief like teammates: a named pointer glides to a paragraph and its suggestion types itself in as a tracked change, a margin comment arrives after a typing mark, and a table lists every change.

items.name: ai-data-01
items.title: Table you can ask
items.description: A customer table you ask in plain words: the question lands as chips you take off one by one while the count rolls, with saved views, sorting, pages, a bulk bar that picks an owner in place and a summary that unfolds under its row word by word.

items.name: ai-data-02
items.title: Calendar with an assistant
items.description: A week of three calendars that finds the time: ask for 45 minutes with two people, the busy time of everyone is shaded, three numbered dashed slots land in the gaps with their reason, and Book turns the one you pick solid while the others leave, with five seconds to undo.

items.name: ai-data-03
items.title: Sorted support inbox
items.description: An inbox an agent has already been through: conversations sorted by topic with the reason for each, a drafted reply with its sources that you send, edit or rewrite, and on Send a check draws itself on the row, which dims where it stands and never moves.

items.name: ai-product-01
items.title: Usage and limits
items.description: Where a workspace stands against its plan: switch the period and the stacked bar by model empties and refills to the limit mark while the daily bars grow from the baseline, with a meter for each other limit and an upgrade line that unfolds near the limit.

items.name: ai-product-02
items.title: Home for an AI app
items.description: The start page of a signed-in AI product: counts roll in once, a question box answers its suggestions, quick actions sit in tiles, and the agents that need you arrive row by row, each with one action that checks itself off, beside cards for spend and finished tasks.

items.name: ai-product-03
items.title: Leads an agent enriches
items.description: A leads table with sorting, search, status and owner filters, selection and pages, while an agent works down it: a row lights, a cell shimmers as its value is fetched, then the value settles into place and the count of enriched leads rolls.

items.name: ai-product-04
items.title: Launch perks
items.description: Three perks of a launch offer under a live countdown: as people join, each claimed count rolls while its bar fills, and a claim turns its button into a drawn check.

items.name: ai-product-05
items.title: Before and after in one bar
items.description: One bar that shows how a week splits between busywork and judgment: the caption lights word by word and the blocks flip one after another while two percentages tick across, on its own when it enters the screen or following a progress value.

items.name: ai-product-06
items.title: App shelf
items.description: A row of app tiles that walks along itself: the tile in focus lifts a preview card out of itself with a Connect button while its neighbours dim, with arrows to move and Enter to connect.

items.name: ai-product-07
items.title: Direction picker
items.description: Four visual directions drawn as small compositions: the one you pick grows into an editable brief with its palette, type pair and three keywords, then Generate turns into its own progress and the options arrive in order.

items.name: app-shells-01
items.title: Sidebar and inset panel
items.description: A workspace sidebar on the window colour with search, quick create and an account menu, and every page in one rounded panel beside it.

items.name: app-shells-02
items.title: Icon rail sidebar
items.description: The same shell with the sidebar folded into an icon rail that explains itself with tooltips and morphs back to full width.

items.name: app-shells-03
items.title: Settings mode
items.description: The sidebar switches to a settings rail with a way back to the app, beside a settings page of rows that save as you change them.

items.name: auth-01
items.title: Sign in with a one-time code
items.description: An email, then a six-digit code, then signed in: the card resizes between steps, the button turns into its working state and a wrong code says what to do next.

items.name: auth-02
items.title: Sign up with live password rules
items.description: Name, email and password with rules that tick as they are met, a reveal button that swaps its eye, and errors that fold away once you type again.

items.name: auth-03
items.title: Reset password
items.description: Ask for a link, check your email with a resend countdown, choose a new password typed twice, then a confirmation, all in one card that resizes to each step.

items.name: auth-04
items.title: Sign in and pick a workspace
items.description: Google or GitHub in one press, or an email and a six-digit code, then the workspaces with their members and a dashed row that creates one; the card resizes from step to step, and the mark of the workspace picked travels to the middle as it turns into Opening Brightmoor, then lands on a check.

items.name: automations-01
items.title: Rule builder
items.description: An event, conditions and actions on one rail: rows open and close in place, the rule reads back as a sentence as you edit, mistakes fold in under their row and Save becomes Saving then Saved.

items.name: billing-01
items.title: Usage with a spending cap
items.description: Plan meters that turn amber near their limit, on-demand spending against a cap whose marker follows the slider, a card that grows into its editor, and a next invoice that rolls to its new total once the cap is saved.

items.name: blog-01
items.title: Blog index
items.description: A blog index with the latest post on a washed card, topic chips with their counts, a search that can come up empty with the way back, and Load more: pick a topic and the thumb travels to it while the cards that stay glide to their new places and the others fade.

items.name: blog-02
items.title: Blog post
items.description: A post in its own scrolling frame with Copy link, a Share menu, a quote, previous and next and related posts, and a table of contents that folds into one bar on phones: as you read, a thin line fills along the top and the marker of the contents travels to the heading you reached.

items.name: boards-01
items.title: Kanban board
items.description: Tinted lanes that scroll on their own, cards with property chips, issue types and worked time, dragged between lanes with the keyboard or the pointer.

items.name: boards-02
items.title: Board with hidden columns and filters
items.description: The same board with folded lanes gathered at the end, still taking drops, and filters that float one pill with the hidden count and Clear filters.

items.name: boards-03
items.title: Board with limits and swimlanes
items.description: Columns that count against their limits, where a column past its limit tints its header and rolls its count to Over by 1; cards move with the pointer, touch or the keyboard, gather into one lane per person and glide back onto the board, and a quick add at the foot of a column takes Enter and leaves on Escape.

items.name: calendars-01
items.title: Calendar app
items.description: A sidebar with a month that moves the main calendar and colour toggles that filter it, beside a calendar with day, week, month, year and agenda views

items.name: changelog-01
items.title: Release list with Load more
items.description: Dated releases with their kind of change as chips, a summary and a short list, and a Load more that adds the next releases while it is still needed.

items.name: changelog-02
items.title: Changelog by month
items.description: Entries grouped under sticky month headers inside their own scroll frame, a month jump that follows the scroll, type filters with counts, details that open in place and a link to copy for every entry.

items.name: changelog-03
items.title: What’s new popover
items.description: A What’s new button whose unread count rolls down as notes are read, opening a compact list with unread dots that clear, Mark all read and a link to each full note.

items.name: chat-01
items.title: Conversation about a page
items.description: A writing assistant beside a docs page: the reply streams in word by word, Send becomes Stop while it does, and the list follows new text until you scroll up.

items.name: chat-02
items.title: Prompt composer
items.description: A composer that grows with the text, takes files from the picker or a drop, lets you pick a model and fills itself from suggested prompts.

items.name: chat-03
items.title: Reasoning and tool calls
items.description: A reply that shows how long it thought, folds its reasoning, runs two tool calls from running to done and cites its sources.

items.name: contact-01
items.title: Contact form with validation
items.description: Contact details beside a form that checks each field on submit and as you fix it, shows a sending state and morphs into a confirmation.

items.name: ctas-01
items.title: Call to action band
items.description: One lifted band with a title, a short line and a single primary action, stacked on phones.

items.name: ctas-02
items.title: Install command card
items.description: A card with a package manager switch, the matching install command and a copy button whose icon swaps to a check.

items.name: ctas-03
items.title: Call to action with a queue
items.description: A closing band with an email field that checks, sends and confirms, beside a queue of conversations whose marks swap into drawn checks and whose rows dim into Done while the block is on screen.

items.name: dashboards-01
items.title: Overview with a figures band
items.description: Four figures that pick what one line chart draws, a period switch whose figures roll to their new value, and a CSV export built in the browser.

items.name: dashboards-02
items.title: Weekly report
items.description: Hours by day as rounded bars that move to the new week, days ahead as empty slots, and the projects ranked by share with rows that travel to their new place.

items.name: dashboards-03
items.title: Project health
items.description: A sprint goal measured against where the team should be by today, and a short table of workstreams with their health and a filter for the ones that need attention.

items.name: dashboards-04
items.title: Retention cohorts
items.description: Weekly sign-up cohorts as a grid shaded by how many still subscribe, weeks to come as empty slots, a selection ring that travels with the arrow keys and a panel whose figure rolls to the picked week.

items.name: docs-01
items.title: Docs page
items.description: A docs page in its own frame with a sidebar you can search, sections with their counts, a Copy page split button, installation by command or by hand, callouts, previous and next and an On this page rail that follows the reading; the sidebar becomes a sheet on phones. Pick a package manager and only the words that run the command roll to the new ones.

items.name: empty-states-01
items.title: Empty list with one action
items.description: A project list with nothing in it yet: one sentence on what is missing and the action that adds the first project, which then takes the place of the empty slot.

items.name: empty-states-02
items.title: Search with no results
items.description: A people list whose search and role filter match nobody, saying what is applied and how to get everyone back with Clear filters.

items.name: empty-states-03
items.title: Block that failed to load
items.description: A page of cards where one block failed (simulated) and shows a notice with Retry, while the other cards keep working.

items.name: empty-states-04
items.title: Empty states with a scene
items.description: Four calm scenes for no runs, an empty inbox, no tools and no agents, drawn with dashed slots and key caps and looping on opacity and transform while on screen, each with a title, a line and one action that morphs from idle to done.

items.name: error-pages-01
items.title: Page not found
items.description: A calm 404 with a search that suggests pages as you type, the typed words marked, popular pages and Go home: on the folded map above, the trail that stops at the fold draws itself on to a pin as soon as a page matches.

items.name: error-pages-02
items.title: Server error
items.description: A 500 with Try again, the status of the service and an error ID that copies with a check: Try again morphs into Retrying while the lights of the failing server run, falls back with a nudge the first time and turns them green on the second.

items.name: error-pages-03
items.title: Maintenance
items.description: A maintenance page with what is affected and a form that checks the address, saves it and folds into a confirmation with a drawn check: the time left counts down in large figures whose minutes roll down as each one passes, over a line that fills toward the end of the window.

items.name: faqs-01
items.title: Grouped questions beside the title
items.description: The title, topic links and a support action on the left, questions grouped by topic on the right, each answer opening with the panel height transition.

items.name: faqs-02
items.title: Centered questions with a contact line
items.description: A centred heading, the questions on one card and a line that names who answers the rest.

items.name: faqs-03
items.title: Searchable questions
items.description: A search that ignores accents and marks its matches in place as you type, topic chips whose counts roll with the words, answers that open where they are with a link to copy, and a person to ask when nothing matches.

items.name: features-01
items.title: Alternating feature rows
items.description: Three rows that swap sides on wide screens, each pairing a short text with an invoice, a reminder list or a payment list drawn from primitives.

items.name: features-02
items.title: Six small features
items.description: A split heading above six short items, each led by a key cap icon tile, two of them with their shortcut.

items.name: features-03
items.title: Feature list with a live preview
items.description: Four views in a list whose indicator travels to the picked one, beside a preview that resizes and crossfades to show it.

items.name: features-04
items.title: Live features
items.description: Five tiles of one agent run, each the working control: a prompt with a status tray, a plan that ticks, an approval that waits for you, a context ring that fills and a cost that rolls.

items.name: features-05
items.title: A planner that hands work to agents
items.description: A section where one planner reads the checklist of a month-end close and hands each part to an agent: three duties with the mark of each agent beside a pulse that runs from the planner to the agents and out to the tools each one was given.

items.name: filters-01
items.title: Amount filter over a histogram
items.description: A popover that draws how the invoices spread by amount, lights the bars inside the range as the handles move, glides them to a common range and counts the matches before the list applies them.

items.name: footers-01
items.title: Footer with categories and a newsletter
items.description: Four lists of links beside the brand and a newsletter field that checks the address, shows its submitting state and morphs into a confirmation.

items.name: footers-02
items.title: Compact footer
items.description: The mark and the copyright, one row of links and the social links, centred and stacked on phones.

items.name: footers-03
items.title: Footer with a wordmark
items.description: Three lists of links beside the brand and a contact address, a back to top button whose arrow travels on hover, and the product name set across the full width at the bottom.

items.name: footers-04
items.title: Footer with a folding sitemap
items.description: Five link columns that fold into an accordion on phones, a support address with a copy button that confirms with a check, and a language select.

items.name: footers-05
items.title: Footer with a closing call to action
items.description: A last headline with a primary action whose arrow travels on hover, then the brand, one row of links and a link to the status page.

items.name: headers-01
items.title: Navbar with a sliding menu panel
items.description: A marketing navbar whose menu panel resizes and slides between Product, Solutions and Resources, with an expanding menu on phones.

items.name: headers-02
items.title: Minimal floating navbar
items.description: A rounded bar with four links under a highlight that follows the pointer, and a sheet that holds the links on phones.

items.name: help-center-01
items.title: Help center
items.description: A help center with a search hero, topics, popular articles and a person to write to: as you type, suggestions land under the field with your words marked, and the count on every topic rolls down to the articles that match while the topics with none step back.

items.name: help-center-02
items.title: Help article
items.description: A help article with breadcrumbs, numbered steps, a note, related articles and a person to write to: answer Was this helpful and the question turns into a thank-you in the same place, after a short field for what was missing when the answer is No.

items.name: heroes-01
items.title: Split hero
items.description: The title on the left, a short paragraph and two actions on the right, under an announcement link.

items.name: heroes-02
items.title: Centered hero with a live board
items.description: A centred title above a planning board drawn from primitives, where one card keeps travelling across the lanes and a rule reacts when it lands in Done.

items.name: heroes-03
items.title: Hero with an email capture
items.description: A waitlist field that checks the address, shows its submitting state and morphs into a confirmation.

items.name: heroes-04
items.title: Statement hero
items.description: An oversized statement above a row of the three facts it rests on: as the raised card travels from fact to fact, the part of the statement that fact backs takes the brand ink.

items.name: heroes-05
items.title: Hero with a product view
items.description: A centred hero over a framed view of the app, where requests arrive and ship on their own: the view starts tilted back in 3D and lays itself flat as the page scrolls.

items.name: heroes-06
items.title: Hero with a live run
items.description: A hero for an AI product whose last word turns over, with an install command to copy and an agent run beside it: the plan ticks while two tool calls land their results under the ink of a run in progress.

items.name: heroes-07
items.title: Hero with a chat box
items.description: A hero for an AI product whose prompt box types its own questions into the empty field, one after another, while app tiles orbit it on two dashed circles and stay upright as they turn.

items.name: heroes-08
items.title: Hero on a grid
items.description: A centred hero on a square grid where app tiles fade into its cells and out again, never two neighbours at once, around a headline that keeps the page colour.

items.name: heroes-09
items.title: Hero with a word pill
items.description: A centred hero whose headline ends in a pill that rolls to the next agent word while its colour sweeps in from the left, with the row of agent tiles above lighting the one the word belongs to.

items.name: heroes-10
items.title: Waitlist hero
items.description: A waitlist hero with an email field that checks the address and morphs into You are on the list, above a stack of avatars where each new member slides in while the oldest tucks under a rolling counter.

items.name: heroes-11
items.title: Typographic hero
items.description: A hero that is mostly its headline, set large: the words land one after another, with small icon tiles standing between some of them, and the lead and two actions follow.

items.name: heroes-12
items.title: Hero with a drawn agent
items.description: A hero for a creator's home page with a drawn agent whose eyes follow the pointer and blink, beside a headline whose last words type, hold, erase and give way to the next phrase.

items.name: heroes-13
items.title: Cloud of points that follows the page
items.description: A hero, a chat that plays a sample exchange with its tool lines and three abilities that each run on sample data, over one cloud of points that follows the scroll: a sphere behind the hero, a ring around the chat and a wave under the abilities.

items.name: integrations-01
items.title: Integrations directory
items.description: Real tools with their marks, by category and with a search, where Connect becomes Connecting then Connected in the same pill, an approval error folds in under its card, and the grid closes ranks as cards leave a view.

items.name: integrations-02
items.title: Integrations marquee
items.description: Three rows of tool marks drifting at their own pace, the middle one the other way, under the product mark, with a heading, a line and one action.

items.name: integrations-03
items.title: Integration areas
items.description: One card per area of tools with a short line, a tool count, a link and a cluster of round marks that float gently.

items.name: integrations-04
items.title: Tools under glass
items.description: Rows of tool marks drift in grey under a clear capsule that shows each in its own colour; press one and the capsule grows into a panel to connect it, and connected tools keep their colour in the rows.

items.name: legal-01
items.title: Policies with a section index
items.description: Terms, privacy and cookies in one page: a rail of documents whose highlight travels, each document crossfading in place with its reading time and a short summary, and an index whose marker follows the section being read.

items.name: legal-02
items.title: Cookie choices
items.description: A consent banner that never covers the page, where Reject all weighs as much as Accept all and Customize opens a dialog of switches with Necessary locked on and its reason; a saved choice calls back, and the banner fades out leaving a small Cookie settings link behind to reopen it.

items.name: logo-clouds-01
items.title: Marquee of placeholder marks
items.description: Neutral drawn marks with fictional names that scroll in a continuous loop, pause under the pointer and wrap into a still row when motion is reduced.

items.name: logo-clouds-02
items.title: Static row of placeholder marks
items.description: A short line on the left and six drawn marks with fictional names in one row, two columns on phones.

items.name: maps-01
items.title: Agent activity globe
items.description: A dotted globe beside the live runs, tokens and spend of four regions: each hand-off turns the globe to show both regions and draws its arc between them while the counts roll in the list, and picking a region turns the globe back to it.

items.name: maps-02
items.title: Map of live runs
items.description: A dotted world map of six regions joined by routes: each run handed off travels its route as a light in the colour of its agent and lands with a ring while the count rolls, and every region is a button whose bubble says how many runs it holds now.

items.name: notifications-01
items.title: Inbox from a bell
items.description: A bell with a dot while something is unread, opening an inbox where each row leads with the task, then the event, with read and archive actions in the place of the age.

items.name: notifications-02
items.title: Toasts in context
items.description: Four small forms that each raise a toast through the Toaster of sonner.tsx: a success out of view, a failure with its reason and Retry, a loading toast that becomes its result, and an archive with Undo.

items.name: notifications-03
items.title: In-page notices
items.description: Notices in the flow of a page, each with a status orb, one line, an action that resolves it in place and a quiet link to the source it is about.

items.name: notifications-04
items.title: Inbox with a reading pane
items.description: Notifications grouped by day beside the one selected: read, archive with Undo, filter by unread or mentions, and reply in place.

items.name: onboarding-01
items.title: Onboarding checklist
items.description: First-run steps on a card for a corner of the dashboard: pressing the action of the current step draws its check, the ring fills and the next step unlocks and opens, Snooze folds the card into a pill that keeps the count, and the last step turns it into a short message that fades on its own.

items.name: onboarding-02
items.title: Setup wizard
items.description: Four steps on the stepper, each checked before it lets go: a refused entry says why and takes the focus, optional steps can be skipped, the card resizes from one step to the next, the review jumps back to any step with Edit, and Create workspace turns into Creating then into the workspace that now exists.

items.name: onboarding-03
items.title: New workspace with a first agent
items.description: A new workspace in four steps on one card: tools go from Connect to Connecting to Connected, addresses become chips, the agent gets a name, a model and a job, and each finished step folds into one line under a check that draws itself, until the first run ticks through its plan and two tool calls and its result lands.

items.name: page-headers-01
items.title: Page header that condenses
items.description: A project header with breadcrumbs, a status, people, progress and tabs whose indicator travels, where Watch, Share and Edit fold into More as the width shrinks: scroll the page under it and the header condenses into a slim bar that keeps the title, the status, Edit and the progress as its lower edge.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Two plans with a billing switch
items.description: A monthly and yearly segmented switch whose thumb travels while the digits of both prices roll to their new value, over two plans with example prices.

items.name: pricing-02
items.title: One plan with a feature table
items.description: A per-seat plan whose seat count and monthly total roll to their new value when changed, beside a grouped table of everything it includes.

items.name: pricing-03
items.title: Seats and usage calculator
items.description: Seats and recording hours set on sliders you can drag, key through or type into, with ticks where the plan changes: a lifted marker glides to the plan that fits while every figure of the month rolls, and a seat-cap notice offers its one-click fix.

items.name: pricing-04
items.title: Pricing in one sentence
items.description: A sentence whose number you type or drag sideways, over a log track notched wherever the cheapest plan changes: the cheapest of three plans lifts out of the row as the volume crosses a notch, while every price rolls with the hand.

items.name: pricing-05
items.title: Plan card with a pattern
items.description: One plan on a solid panel inside a tray of hairline zigzags that drift while it is on screen, with a billing switch whose price rolls its digits to the yearly figure.

items.name: pricing-06
items.title: Plan comparison
items.description: Three plans compared under a header that sticks with each price and action, where Only differences folds away every row the plans share and the rest close ranks, with one accordion per plan on narrow screens.

items.name: search-01
items.title: Search results
items.description: Search over a local index with the count and the real time it took, type facets, pages of results with their breadcrumbs and matches marked, and a correction when nothing matches: each letter you type narrows the results while every facet count rolls, and the arrows walk a highlight through them for Enter to open.

items.name: settings-01
items.title: Profile form
items.description: A profile in three sections with a travelling highlight, a photo picked in the browser, errors that fold in and out, and an unsaved-changes bar whose Save becomes Saving then Saved.

items.name: settings-02
items.title: Notifications by channel
items.description: Email, push and desktop as sections, each led by its channel switch that folds its events away, with a digest choice, quiet hours and the same unsaved-changes bar.

items.name: settings-03
items.title: Workspace settings
items.description: Name and address, the default role for new members read against who holds each role, and a danger zone where archiving takes a two-second hold and deleting takes the typed name.

items.name: settings-04
items.title: API keys
items.description: Live and test keys whose spend this month rolls as calls come in, with idle keys flagged; Create key unfolds a form in place and shows the secret once with Copy, a row opens to its scopes, its creator and two weeks of requests, and Revoke fills across a two-second hold before the row folds away.

items.name: settings-05
items.title: Security
items.description: Sign-in accounts that connect and disconnect, with a confirm in place before the last way in goes; signed-in devices with this one marked, where a device signed out folds away and the others go after one confirm; and a two-step switch that grows its setup panel while the six digits of the first code fill in.

items.name: settings-06
items.title: License keys
items.description: A card per product whose key shows again group by group, Copy that turns into a check, seats in use on a meter, and Regenerate behind an in-place warning that the old key stops, after which the key rolls to its new groups while the seats empty and fill again as machines come back.

items.name: settings-07
items.title: Billing
items.description: The plan with its status, renewal and a chooser whose highlight travels, meters that turn amber near their limit as runs come in, invoices that download, a drawn card that Update card replaces, and Cancel subscription that confirms in place and turns the plan into Cancels on 30 Nov with Resume beside it.

items.name: stats-01
items.title: Figures band
items.description: Three illustrative figures with their labels, a detail line, a proof drawn under each and a source footnote: switch the period and every figure rolls to its new value while the trend line glides and the bars rise or fall, and hover or focus brings up what each figure is compared to.

items.name: stats-02
items.title: Results section
items.description: A dark section with a mission line, three results that count up once with what each is compared to, and a card set at an angle whose ring closes as its score rolls.

items.name: task-detail-01
items.title: Task drawer
items.description: A task opened in a sheet docked beside the page, with arrows that walk the list, properties to pick in place, child issues, a filtered feed and a comment field pinned at the foot.

items.name: task-detail-02
items.title: Task page with a property rail
items.description: The same task as a page: a reading column beside a rail of folding sections for properties, time and details, which joins the column on narrow screens.

items.name: task-detail-03
items.title: Task with work tabs
items.description: A task page whose sub-tasks, comments and activity share one card behind a segmented switch, each count rolling as you check, add and comment

items.name: task-detail-04
items.title: Task with a conversation pane
items.description: The task beside a pinned conversation where comments and changes interleave, a teammate types an answer and the panes become a switch on phones

items.name: task-lists-01
items.title: Grouped task list
items.description: Tasks grouped by status under sticky bands, on one grid shared with the column labels, with a scope switch, a search field on the slash key and a filter menu.

items.name: task-lists-02
items.title: Task list with bulk edits
items.description: The grouped task list with row selection, shift-click ranges and a floating bar that changes the status, priority or assignees of every selected task.

items.name: team-01
items.title: Member cards on one grid
items.description: The column labels and every member card share one grid: presence, current task with its status, time today, estimate and a total that opens the day.

items.name: team-02
items.title: Member table
items.description: The same members and columns as one table surface, sortable by name and by time, with pending invitations at the end.

items.name: team-03
items.title: Invite flow
items.description: A sheet with Invite and Invited tabs that turns addresses into chips, beside the list of pending invitations it keeps up to date.

items.name: team-04
items.title: Team overview
items.description: A team page with its figures for this week or last, the members with their current task and hours, and the activity of the person picked.

items.name: team-sections-01
items.title: Team grid
items.description: The people behind a product as cards with their drawn picture, role, city, a bio clamped to three lines and labelled social links, beside a dashed seat for the open role: Read more opens a bio in place, the card growing to fit it while its label rolls to Show less.

items.name: team-sections-02
items.title: Team list
items.description: The team as rows grouped by team, each with its drawn picture, role and city and a bio behind a toggle: the open row lifts onto a card while its bio and social links unfold under it and its chevron turns.

items.name: team-sections-03
items.title: Team showcase
items.description: The team as a spotlight over a picker of people: picking someone sends the raised spotlight gliding to them while their profile opens in place on the featured card, with what to ask them about, their links and a button that copies their email address.

items.name: testimonials-01
items.title: Quote wall
items.description: Sample customer quotes on a masonry wall with one phrase of each in the brand ink: pick a theme and a marker sweeps under the phrases that say it while the other quotes step back to muted text.

items.name: testimonials-02
items.title: Quote carousel
items.description: One sample quote at a time: the bar under the current quote fills while it waits and the next one slides in from the side it comes from, held under the pointer, by keyboard focus and off screen, with Pause, arrows and keyed dots.

items.name: testimonials-03
items.title: One large quote
items.description: One sample quote set large on the featured card, with the person, their role and their company: the phrase it praises is a button whose chevron turns as the feature it speaks of unfolds under the quote.

items.name: testimonials-04
items.title: Quote stage
items.description: A large drawn portrait beside one big sample quote, switched with tabs, arrows and the progress row under the tabs: the row fills up to the person picked while their portrait and quote crossfade in, and an optional autoplay waits under the pointer and off screen.

items.name: testimonials-05
items.title: Quotes with results
items.description: One customer at a time on the featured card over a wall of short sample quotes with their result chips: pick a quote, or let the block turn every few seconds, and the quote writes itself in word by word while the illustrative figure beside it rolls to that customer’s result.

items.name: workflows-01
items.title: Workflow builder
items.description: A canvas where steps are connected by hand: a wire follows the pointer out of a port and lands on the steps that can take it, the warning marks clear as it lands, and Publish refuses with a count until the last problem is fixed in the inspector.

items.name: workflows-02
items.title: Node graph editor
items.description: A pipeline of typed nodes with their settings inside: a wire between two ports of different types is refused with a shake of its end and the reason, Run lights the nodes in order as their ring closes, one fails with Retry, and the next run serves what did not change from cache.

items.name: application-07
items.title: Agent operations
items.description: A Sundermere operations page on one run: a header that condenses into a slim bar as the page scrolls, a live graph where an edge draws itself and a dot travels out and back for each call, a monitor with the command that waits for Allow or Deny, a budget bar that passes its 80% mark, a fleet that makes every panel follow the agent you pick, a trace waterfall and a board whose cards travel between lanes, in three columns that fold to one by container width. Plug your backend into onApprove and onDeny.

items.name: application-06
items.title: Agent workspace
items.description: A Ferrowick agent workspace: sessions grouped by day with a search that go into a sheet on phones, a thread where thinking, tool calls that open to their input and result, result cards and a request waiting for Allow or Deny arrive as the agent works, and a composer that takes photos and files, tools and skills, queues what you write while the agent answers and sets how hard it thinks on a ramp of five dots you tap or drag. Plug your agent into onSend, onApprove and onDeny.

items.name: application-10
items.title: Research agent
items.description: A Corvale research agent: a question starts a live timeline of thinking, searching and reading in the thread while the memo writes itself section by section in the panel beside it, a sheet on phones, then the answer cites numbered sources that light up and a request to share waits for Allow or Deny. Plug your agent into onSend, onApprove and onDeny.

items.name: application-12
items.title: Coding agent
items.description: A Kettlebrook coding agent: a task in the thread, the files it reads with their marks, a failing test whose output streams in the Tests tab, the fix written hunk by hunk in Diff, then the same output turning from failing to passing while the count rolls to 7 of 7, the checkout page before and after in Preview and a pull request that waits for Allow or Deny, over a footer with the branch, the tokens and the cost. Plug your agent into onSend, onApprove and onDeny.

items.name: application-13
items.title: Agent start screen
items.description: A Wrenfield start screen for an agent app: recent sessions down the side, one prompt box with attachments, a model key and a mode key, suggested tasks that fill the prompt when picked and the latest runs with their state, where a run that waits is allowed or denied in place. Behind it a field of mono glyphs shows in a soft lens that follows the pointer, and a press on empty space sends a ripple through it. Plug your agent into onSend, onApprove and onDeny.

items.name: application-04
items.title: Sign in
items.description: A focused Loomboard page: sign in with a one-time code, with links to create an account and to reset a password, all in one card that resizes from one flow to the next.

items.name: marketing-04
items.title: Changelog page
items.description: A Loomboard changelog: the navbar with Changelog marked, dated releases with their kind of change and a Load more that adds the next ones, and a footer with a newsletter field.

items.name: application-05
items.title: Assistant
items.description: A Quillstone assistant: conversations on the left that go into a sheet on phones, a reply that streams in while Send becomes Stop, a composer that takes files and a model, a reply that folds its reasoning and runs two tool calls, and a new chat that starts from suggested prompts.

items.name: application-08
items.title: Chat with run details
items.description: A Quenby chat with run details: chats grouped by day with a search, a sidebar that collapses and goes into a sheet on phones, a thread where the assistant thinks, asks before it reads a shared file and cites numbered sources that light up, a model picker, Send that becomes Stop, and a details panel from the header whose plan, calls, tokens and cost move as the run goes. Plug your assistant into onSend, onApprove, onDeny and onStop.

items.name: marketing-05
items.title: Contact page
items.description: A Driftdesk contact page: contact details beside a form that checks each field, shows a sending state and morphs into a confirmation, grouped questions and a compact footer.

items.name: application-09
items.title: AI app dashboard
items.description: A Kivuline Roasters dashboard on the app shell: a sidebar with workspaces that goes into a sheet on phones, a top bar with search and a bell, a figures band, the agents that need you with Allow and Deny, recent activity and a usage ring. Allow a request and the whole page answers at once: the row folds away, the counts roll down, a line lands at the top of the activity and the ring grows. Plug your app into onApprove, onDeny and onWorkspaceChange.

items.name: application-15
items.title: CRM overview
items.description: A Pebblecrest CRM start page: three figures that count up once, accounts and contacts as one graph whose nodes glide between five layouts (cluster, rings, grid, orbit, radial), the agent's recent runs with a request that waits for Allow or Deny, a to-do list, a pipeline funnel that reshapes when the agent qualifies leads, the trend of new leads and the next 14 days, with sections that open from the sidebar, a sheet on phones. Plug your CRM into onTaskChange, onApprove and onDeny.

items.name: application-16
items.title: Marketing dashboard
items.description: A Tarnbrook marketing dashboard whose sidebar and cards settle in once, then one period switch moves every chart together: leads split by origin, goals as tick meters, daily traffic against the period before dashed, clicks by channel and month, a conversion funnel, the week's campaigns on a strip and a table of campaigns grouped by channel that sorts by column. Plug your analytics into onPeriodChange, onSortChange and onCampaignSelect.

items.name: application-02
items.title: Analytics
items.description: Tidewell Studio reports in the sidebar shell: an overview whose figures pick what the chart draws, a weekly report with day bars and ranked projects, and project health against the sprint goal, each with a CSV export.

items.name: marketing-06
items.title: Docs site
items.description: A Wickerline docs site in one component: a home with one search across every page and three category cards, then pages with the sidebar, a page header, install steps whose package manager rolls the command, callouts, a table of events, an On this page rail and previous and next links. A small router keeps the state, and a search for install opens the page while bun rolls into the command.

items.name: application-11
items.title: Support inbox
items.description: An Oatfield support inbox: tickets with status, priority and unread marks beside the conversation and a copilot that reads the ticket, fills the customer card and searches the help center, then its draft arrives in the reply box with its sources to insert, edit or discard, a refund waits for Allow or Deny and the answered ticket travels to Solved. Plug your help desk into onSend, onApprove and onDeny.

items.name: marketing-07
items.title: Shared card launch page
items.description: A Tallypot launch page: group cards in a coverflow that follows the hand and keeps its momentum, a large figure that drops in with one burst of confetti, shapes that pop in as sections arrive, a live feed of who paid what in a split, perks whose meters fill with the group spend, a flap countdown to the launch and a share action.

items.name: marketing-03
items.title: Per-seat pricing page
items.description: A Tallyfold pricing page: one plan whose seat count and monthly total roll to their new value when changed, a grouped table of what it includes, questions on one card and a compact footer.

items.name: application-03
items.title: Settings
items.description: Lattice Studio settings: a settings rail with a way back to the app, a profile, notifications by channel and the workspace page, each saving through one unsaved-changes bar, with saved names showing in the sidebar at once.

items.name: application-01
items.title: Team workspace
items.description: A Mossline workspace: a sidebar that hides and goes into a sheet on phones, My tasks grouped by status whose rows open a task drawer, an inbox behind the bell and as a page, a board whose moves change the same tasks, and the team with time today.

items.name: application-14
items.title: Workflow builder
items.description: An Alderbank workflow builder: an email triage flow on a canvas that pans and zooms, a palette that adds a step where you point, an inspector that sets up each kind of step, and undo and redo that walk every edit. A test run travels down the flow step by step: the branch it takes fills with the primary colour while the others dim, a carrier call fails once then passes on its second try, the reply streams in the inspector and a refund waits for Allow or Deny on its step. Plug your backend into onRun, onSave, onPublish, onApprove, onDeny and onChange.
